title: Schools: a cooperative panel, nothing to flag
note: The precision test. Questions asked and answered, one follow-up, one natural move to a new subject, and no cue: Hepta should flag nothing and say nothing.

turns.speaker: MOD
turns.text: Tonight, schools. Teacher, what is the biggest pressure in the classroom right now?

turns.speaker: TCH
turns.text: Class sizes. I teach 34 children in a room built for 25.

turns.speaker: PAR
turns.text: It's the same at my daughter's school. They've had three supply teachers this year.

turns.speaker: MOD
turns.text: Parent, what would you change first?

turns.speaker: PAR
turns.text: More teachers and smaller classes, even if it means a higher council tax.

turns.speaker: TCH
turns.text: On council tax, most of my colleagues would happily pay a bit more for that.

turns.speaker: MOD
turns.text: Let's move on to exams. Teacher, are the new exams working?

turns.speaker: TCH
turns.text: Mostly, yes. Results are steadier and the marking is fairer.

turns.speaker: PAR
turns.text: My son found the new format less stressful, to be honest.

turns.speaker: MOD
turns.text: Thank you both. We'll leave it there.
